pictures.name: MFT1-Forest-Retreat
pictures.prompt: A deep, ancient Indian forest at dusk in the rainy season. Several young monks in ochre robes sit in meditation at the roots of enormous old trees, wet leaves glistening, mist between the trunks. In the middle, a young forest monk (shaved head, ochre robe, thin lean face, wide uncertain eyes) sits upright, eyes closed. Gold light through the canopy, deep blue shadow. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
